title: UFOs appearing around high-voltage experiments and particle accelerators
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFOs appearing around high-voltage experiments and particle accelerators, about unspecified at particle accelerators and high-voltage labs, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: show up, you know, high voltage experimentation, particle accelerators, and they seem to again anecdotally show up around some of these things as well.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that UFOs seem to show up, anecdotally, around high-voltage experiments and particle accelerators, the huge machines physicists use to smash tiny particles together. He doesn't name any particular lab or date. If true, it would hint that whatever is behind UFOs is drawn to our most powerful energy and physics work.
